To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the ligand specificities of the zebrahish PTH receptors are different from that of their human counterparts.

(1) zPTH1 receptor is a functional ortholog of mammalian PTHR1; (2) zPTH2 receptor recognizes TIP39 as an endogenous ligand; (3) the zPTH3 receptor is a novel PTH receptor; (4) PTHrP and PTH have similar potency at zPTH3 receptors; and (5) the zPTH1 and zPTH3 receptors are expressed in the same cell type in the zebrafisch pituit
the zPTH3 receptor, like the mammalian PTHrP receptor, is selective for PHTP over PTH.

the development of new drugs for the treatment of osteoporosis, and the use of zebrafish to identify new ligands for PTH1 receptors, as well as to evaluate the ligand selectivity of the zebrahfish PTH2 receptor.

understanding the molecular basis of PTH receptor signaling and ligand recognition.

the ligand specificities of zPTH1, zPTH2 and zPTH3 receptors are very similar to their mammalian counterparts, with some interesting exceptions.

the PTH2 receptor is not only a receptor for PTH, but also a high affinity receptor for TIP39.
